title: Microcourse in German Studies; Practicum in German Theater
description: Students will stage a brief one-act play of contemporary relevance, chosen in consultation with the instructor, for the One Stage, Many Languages: A Contemporary Global Theatre Festival hosted by the School of Languages, Literatures, and Cultures in late April 2026. Acting encouraged but not required. The play will be performed in German with English overtitles. Course taught in English, but students must have completed GERS103 to enroll.
